description: An MCP server (SIMULATOR build) implementing the Evidence Weaver core of the Eclipse Thread family: it ingests four export shapes — a Jira-DC-shaped REST export, a SARIF findings file, a VectorCAST-shaped coverage report, and an XMI-lite model export — into one artifact graph (requirements, model elements, code units, test cases, findings, tickets) with typed trace links and provenance on every artifact. It runs gap-first trace analysis (unlinked requirements, untested code, orphan tests, findings without tickets, per-layer coverage), and assembles deterministic, hash-chained evidence packages that verify standalone. Includes a Jira Data Center bridge client written against the DC REST v2 shape and exercised over real HTTP against a bundled stdlib stub server. Assembly and transport only — no verification results are generated and no compliance claims are made.
